gui.guhs.einde2_verhaal.hervat.portaal: Go back to the Guh End through your portal. At the Nibble Mountain, where you come out, the cheese ball glows: click it and you are right back in your story.
gui.guhs.einde2_verhaal.hervat.kaasbol: Far from your story? Click the glowing cheese ball at the Nibble Mountain (%s): it takes you straight back.
gui.guhs.einde2_verhaal.hervat.kaasbol_h: The cheese ball glows close by. Click it and you are right back in your story.
gui.guhs.einde2_verhaal.hervat.kaasbol_b: Click the cheese ball: on with your story!
gui.guhs.einde2_verhaal.hervat.verder: The cheese ball glows brightly... and takes you back to your story!
gui.guhs.einde2_verhaal.hervat.geest: This step takes place in the Spirit World: meditate again at the spot where you meditated last time.
gui.guhs.einde2_verhaal.hervat.wacht: The wind is still finding the way. Try again in a moment, njeg.
gui.guhs.einde2_verhaal.hervat.geen_plek: The cheese ball knows no place for this step. Look in your Guhdex (Tales) for where to go.
gui.guhs.einde2_verhaal.hervat.niets: There is no story to continue right now.
gui.guhs.einde2_verhaal.h1.scooter: The start of the Air Scooter Track is %s, southwest of the forecourt.
gui.guhs.einde2_verhaal.h1.zweven: The south balcony at the top of the Great Tower is %s. Jump off: you glide and slowly sink. Steer through the rings in the shortest line you can.
gui.guhs.einde2_verhaal.h1.deur: The closed door of the workshop is %s, in the building east of the hall. Just walk into it.
gui.guhs.einde2_verhaal.h1.les.1: Did you see that? That ball didn't fly because of your hand, but because of the wind you gave it. That was airbending! A tiny bit, njeg.
gui.guhs.einde2_verhaal.h1.les.2: Now without a ball. Press %s, pick Air Leap in your power wheel and jump on the wind!
gui.guhs.einde2_verhaal.h1.les.3: Air Leap and Air Ball work everywhere in the temple. Go on, try them!
gui.guhs.einde2_verhaal.h1.les.sprong: Whoa, did you see how high? Air doesn't push, air lifts you up. Now try Air Ball: a gust wherever you look.
gui.guhs.einde2_verhaal.h1.les.bal: Whoosh! That's it! Air is light and free. You'll learn the rest on the way: running, gliding... and maybe one day blowing away a fireball.
scene.guhs.einde2_verhaal_kijk_h1_scoote: This is where the Air Scooter Track begins.
scene.guhs.einde2_verhaal_kijk_h1_zweven: The south balcony. Jump, and trust the wind.
scene.guhs.einde2_verhaal_kijk_h1_deur.t: Something is ticking... behind that door.
